facts.fact: Minister Samuel Nartey George said on 7 September 2026 that the strategy, led by academics, was launched (a prototype was shown at the launch) and that universities are central to it.

The minister said President Mahama announced $20 million of government support for local AI capacity and a $250 million computing allocation, both awaiting operationalisation, and that UK FCDO gave 500,000 pounds to academic institutions for developing the strategy plus a further 6 million pounds in UK support; the $20m is not explicitly tied to the strategy.
